name: respawn-server
description: Zentrales Tool fuer die LAN Party: Matchmaking, Abstimmung, Live-Status, Leaderboard

scripts.test: npm run test:compile && npm run test:run
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e:prepare && npm run test:e2e:run:all
scripts.test:e2e:core: npm run test:e2e:prepare && npm run test:e2e:run:core
scripts.test:e2e:arcade: npm run test:e2e:prepare && npm run test:e2e:run:arcade
scripts.test:e2e:arcade-smoke: npm run test:e2e:prepare && npm run test:e2e:run:arcade-smoke
scripts.test:e2e:run:all: cross-env NODE_ENV=test E2E_FAST_TIMERS=1 node scripts/run-e2e-partition.mjs all
scripts.test:e2e:run:core: cross-env NODE_ENV=test E2E_FAST_TIMERS=1 node scripts/run-e2e-partition.mjs core
scripts.test:e2e:run:arcade: cross-env NODE_ENV=test E2E_FAST_TIMERS=1 node scripts/run-e2e-partition.mjs arcade
scripts.test:e2e:run:arcade-smoke: cross-env NODE_ENV=test E2E_FAST_TIMERS=1 node scripts/run-e2e-partition.mjs arcade-smoke
